versions.change: Initial release with 12 primary sources, eight operating controls, methodology, JSON and CSV distributions.
Added the enacted TAKE IT DOWN Act and SAG-AFTRA interactive digital-replica guidance, and updated C2PA from specification 2.2 to 2.4.
Replaced the superseded 2025 NO FAKES proposal with S.4591, recorded its committee advance and the September 30 floor objection, and rechecked the C2PA 2.4 and UK digital-replica sources.
Added enacted New York rules for digital-replica contracts and synthetic performers in advertising, plus the 2026 EU AI Act amendment on non-consensual intimate material and consent safeguards.
